author: IGN
description:
Compete to build the perfect monster. Then unleash it to hunt your rival scientists either in roguelite single-player or social hangout multiplayer. Check out the latest Frankenstein's Monster trailer for another look at this upcoming game. A single-player playtest is available on Steam. Frankenstein's Monster will be available on PC in 2026.

It’s 1818. Starting in your lab, explore a huge hand-drawn map, swapping and raiding parts to build a new monster, competing against 3 rival scientists doing the same. You’re helped by a previous monster from your collection - who will hunt down the other scientists. Due to your hippocratic oath, any body part you take must have one left in its place, so be careful not to leave your rival a part they need... When time’s up attention shifts to the prestigious scientific society, which judges who has the best build - win to increase your reputation, unlocking new abilities. If your monster’s a perfect build it’s added to your collection.

#ign #ga
title: Frankenstein's Monster - Official Playtest Announce Trailer

author: IGN
description:
The Spire has evolved, and so has the game that defined the roguelike deckbuilder genre. Slay the Spire 2 takes us 1,000 years into the future with a complete engine overhaul, a striking new art style, and the addition of a long-requested official co-op mode. From the soul-harvesting mechanics of the Necrobinder to the celestial power of the Regent, Mega Crit is introducing more ways to break the game than ever before. We’re breaking down the biggest differences between Slay the Spire 1 and 2, including new card types, the mysterious Ancients, and how your favorite returning characters have been totally reworked.

Slay the Spire 2 is currently in Early Access, and we're looking at how the sequel revamps the classic loop with new card enchantments, quest cards, and alternate acts. Whether you're a veteran with a thousand hours in the original or a newcomer looking for a guide to the new mechanics, this breakdown covers the essential changes to relics, potions, and enemy behaviors like
title: Slay the Spire 2 - 15 Biggest Changes From Slay the Spire 1

author: IGN
description:
With Bride of Frankenstein In 1935, director James Whale brought to life more than just a would-be wife for his first monstrous creation. He helped electrify a Hollywood playbook that Marvel, DC and the rest of today’s franchisers are still using. Bride of Frankenstein is a dark and moody sequel, a departure from source material that forges its own path to become the peak of cinema’s Golden Era of movie monsters. But the film’s experiment couldn’t survive the pitchforks of censorship rallying behind the Hays Code in the 30s. IGN’s Scott Collura reviews the 90 year old all-time classic, then talks with Clint Gage about the meta opening scene, the tropes that science fiction still can’t put down and the perfect campiness of little people in glass jars.

IGN’s only been around for 30 years, but movies have been going for much, much longer than that. And the thing is, so many of them have never been reviewed by us. But that’s where IGN’s Flashback Reviews come in, so today we’re jumping a
title: How Bride of Frankenstein Brought Horror to Life Before Censorship Killed It | IGN Flashback Review

author: IGN
description:
Bungie is back with a bold new vision for the extraction shooter, and your survival on Tau Ceti IV depends entirely on the body you drop in with. In Marathon, players inhabit cybernetic "Shells," each boasting unique tactical abilities, prime powers, and specialized traits that define your role in a three-person squad (or as a lone wolf). From the heavy-hitting Destroyer to the loot-obsessed Thief and the mysterious, solo-focused Rook, we’re breaking down the entire launch roster to help you decide which rig fits your playstyle before you initiate your next extraction.

This comprehensive Marathon guide covers all seven starting Shells: Destroyer, Vandal, Recon, Assassin, Triage, Thief, and Rook. We dive into the specific mechanics of each, including the Destroyer’s Riot Barricade, the Vandal’s Disrupt Cannon, and the Triage’s life-saving Reboot+ ability. Whether you’re looking for the best Marathon character for solo play or the ideal team compositions for high-stakes loot runs, this
title: Marathon: Which Shell Should You Pick?

author: IGN
description:
Join developer Liquid Swords for a deep dive into Samson in this latest trailer for the upcoming pressure-driven action experience built around debt, consequences, and survival in one of the most unforgiving cities imaginable. The new video showcases the gritty city of Tyndalston, the vision behind it, the concepts, and how the team built it. Additionally, get a behind-the-scenes look at how the vehicles were built, challenges and joys in making them, and how visual effects amplified the car combat. 

Samson: A Tyndalston Story will be available on Steam and Epic Games Store on April 8, 2026.

#ign #gaming
title: Samson - Official Development Diary: City & Car Design Video
